steps.text: Shopify admin → Apps → Cartivo
Dashboard: live status of the cart drawer and a setup guide
Campaign types you can create
Cart drawer: looks, texts and a live preview
Style: pick a ready-made look, the preview updates live
Keep Liquid glass and save
Upsells: use your upsell campaigns first, then Shopify recommendations
Sticky add-to-cart bar and floating cart button
Campaigns: every offer in one list (older test campaigns are drafts)
Create an in-cart upsell
When The Collection Snowboard: Oxygen is in the cart…
…recommend The Collection Snowboard: Liquid
Save the upsell (saved as a draft)
Activate the campaign: it goes live on the storefront
Create a Buy X Get Y offer
Customer buys The Collection Snowboard: Oxygen…
…and gets The Complete Snowboard at 100% off, added automatically
Create a free gift goal
Tier 1: carts of $100 or more get a free gift
Gift options: the shopper picks one Ski Wax
Three campaigns live: upsell, Buy X Get Y and the free gift goal
Storefront: The Collection Snowboard: Oxygen
Floating cart button (bottom right) on every page
Scroll down: the sticky add-to-cart bar follows the shopper
Add to cart from the sticky bar: the Cartivo cart drawer opens
Buy X Get Y: The Complete Snowboard was added at $0
Goal reached: choose a free gift
The gift is in the cart for free
Upsell: one click adds the recommended board
Close the drawer: the floating button shows the item count
Open the cart again from the floating button
Shopify's cart page: the free board and the gift are $0
End of demo
